issue.title: test_prompt_panel_section_navigation_targets: active_section_identity resolves to None after document rerender
issue.description:
Confirmed true failure on master HEAD 457041681 (2026-09-05), unrelated to any in-flight change. Discovered while verifying the ratchet_core_pin plan's just check run; confirmed pre-existing via git stash of the plan's only diff (sase-core-revision.txt, a CI-only pin file with no local test effect) plus an isolated pytest run of the whole file on clean HEAD (3 failed, 17 passed - deterministic, not order-dependent).

Failing nodes:
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_section_navigation_targets.py::test_resolve_section_at_row_still_resolves_fold_only_anchor
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_section_navigation_targets.py::test_active_section_reconciles_across_same_document_rerender
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_section_navigation_targets.py::test_cheap_paint_preserves_section_until_enriched_layout_returns

All three assert AgentPromptPanel.active_section_identity equals a specific section id after re-rendering an updated document (e.g. re-render with sections ONE/TWO expects active_section_identity == "two"), but it resolves to None instead.

Likely root cause (not yet proven): git log on this test file's last 3 commits shows 969c22ba0 'feat(ace): cache idle prompt-panel renders of unchanged documents' as the most recent change before 1858f7560 'fix(tui): cache prompt panel section visuals' and 71120f321 'test(ace): split prompt panel section navigation tests'. The idle-render caching in 969c22ba0 is the prime suspect for why active-section identity fails to reconcile across a rerender, since caching an unchanged-document render could suppress the active-section recomputation these tests exercise.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: running the whole file in isolation on a clean tree (git stash applied to remove the only unrelated local diff) fails these exact 3 tests every time (3 failed, 17 passed), with no passing rerun observed.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during prompt_search_performance verification on 2026-09-05: main repo just check failed the same three tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_section_navigation_targets.py nodes under the escalated xdist scoped lane. Immediate direct rerun of those three node IDs on the same worktree passed (5-node rerun including the two axe failures: 5 passed), so my observation presents as parallel/order-sensitive on this tree.

Independent reproduction on 2026-09-05 while landing an unrelated split of src/sase/bead/conflict_resolver.py into multiple files (no TUI code touched, tree at master 15c6b7a00). just check's parallel test-scoped lane failed all three listed nodes plus test_get_content_height_reserve_uses_last_title_not_trailing_roster_row from the same file (that fourth node passed on an isolated rerun, unlike these three, so it is reported separately). Matches the deterministic active_section_identity==None-after-rerender failure exactly.

payload.description: same test file and same active_section_identity/rerender navigation-test suite; sase-x6 tracks three deterministic failures in this file while this node instead reproduces only under the parallel lane

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on 2026-09-05 while splitting src/sase/main/init_onboarding.py into multiple files (no TUI code touched). just check's parallel test-scoped lane failed the same three nodes deterministically; confirmed pre-existing via git stash to clean master (same 3 failed, 17 passed on isolated file run) with zero local diff.

Phase sase-x8.1 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1 independently observed 3-4 failures in tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_section_navigation_targets.py during two unrelated full just check runs, with the failing subset varying and the file passing in isolated reruns. The three-node portion matches sase-x6's active_section_identity rerender failures; the phase's artifact-context diff did not touch prompt-panel code.

Independent reproduction relayed from two phase agents of epic sase-x7.2.1 (migration kit), neither of which touched ACE TUI code. (1) sase-x7.2.1.2 on 2026-09-05 21:36 EDT: test_active_section_reconciles_across_same_document_rerender and test_cheap_paint_preserves_section_until_enriched_layout_returns fail deterministically together when tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_section_navigation_targets.py runs as a file, with AgentPromptPanel.active_section_identity resolving to None instead of 'two' - exactly this bead's signature. (2) sase-x7.2.1.3 on 2026-09-05 22:40 EDT: repeated packaging-triggered 'just check' full-suite escalations failed the prompt_panel_section_navigation fold-only anchor node (test_resolve_section_at_row_still_resolves_fold_only_anchor), the third node listed here. Both phases' diffs were confined to src/sase/migration_kit/, src/sase/main/parser_migrate.py, src/sase/main/migrate_handler.py and their tests. Note: on this workspace at master 16153bf56 the whole file now passes 20/20 in isolation, so the deterministic-in-isolation claim in the original report does not reproduce here.
